campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Pétalos de Musk (ARW), connecting luminous citrus, delicate white florals, creamy vanilla, refined cedar and soft musk in a sophisticated feminine visual world.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images must represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity through the same luminous floral-woody atmosphere, core botanical elements, warm ivory-gold palette and tactile premium materials.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Pétalos de Musk (ARW)
fragrance_data.description:
Pétalos de Musk (ARW): un perfume floral ligeramente dulce, elegante y femenino

Pétalos de Musk (ARW) es un perfume floral ligeramente dulce pensado para mujeres que buscan una fragancia sofisticada, delicada y fácil de llevar. Su composición combina la luminosidad de los cítricos, la elegancia de las flores blancas y la calidez de la vainilla de Madagascar con un refinado fondo amaderado.

Este perfume floral ligeramente dulce destaca por su equilibrio entre frescura, dulzura y elegancia, convirtiéndose en una opción perfecta tanto para el día a día como para ocasiones especiales.

 

 

¿A qué huele Pétalos de Musk (ARW)?

Pétalos de Musk (ARW) es un perfume floral ligeramente dulce donde la bergamota, la flor de naranjo, las flores blancas, la vainilla de Madagascar y el cedro crean una fragancia luminosa, femenina y muy sofisticada.

Una salida fresca, cítrica y luminosa

La fragancia comienza con la bergamota y la flor de naranjo, aportando una apertura brillante, fresca y elegante que transmite una agradable sensación de limpieza.

Un corazón floral delicado y refinado

En el desarrollo aparecen las flores blancas, que envuelven la piel con un aroma suave, femenino y lleno de elegancia natural.

Un fondo cálido, avainillado y amaderado

El secado combina la vainilla de Madagascar con la madera de cedro, creando una base cremosa, ligeramente dulce y elegante que deja una estela duradera y muy confortable.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by fragrance_data.notes.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistically sized bergamots, some whole and some freshly cut, with textured green-gold peel and small glossy wedges.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Communicates the luminous, fresh and clean opening of the perfume with a strong tactile and chromatic signature.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A restrained cluster in the foreground and beside the bottle, with one cut fruit revealing translucent citrus flesh.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few bergamots and suspended citrus droplets move slowly through the atmospheric space, with the fruit remaining physically proportionate and clearly separated from the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Natural clusters of small white orange blossoms with delicate green stems and subtle pollen detail.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Connects the sparkling citrus opening to the feminine white-floral heart and introduces the campaign's ivory floral identity.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Grouped in the midground behind and to one side of the bottle, never covering the cap, label or silhouette.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small blossom clusters are suspended within a gentle air current, with a few detached petals moving plausibly through the scene.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Multiple small star-shaped jasmine flowers, some open and some partially closed, arranged in natural botanical clusters.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Adds refined femininity, delicacy and a tactile petal texture without making the scene visually heavy.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A principal floral grouping around the bottle's supporting surface, with overlapping stems creating realistic depth.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Jasmine clusters occupy the middle distance around the bottle while a few petals drift through the controlled atmospheric flow.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several slender Madagascar vanilla pods, some whole and some split lengthwise to reveal dark seeds, with subtle creamy-gold tones.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Provides the fragrance's gentle sweetness and warm tactile base while offering a highly recognizable material contrast to the flowers.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Placed in a low, elegant cluster on the surface near the bottle, with pods partially overlapping cedar fragments.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A small number of vanilla pods float slowly in the midground, integrated into the same warm vapor and light field without forming a rigid geometric pattern.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small realistic cedar chips, thin shavings and a few compact bark fragments with visible grain and warm beige-brown surfaces.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Grounds the floral luminosity with an understated architectural and woody texture, reinforcing sophistication and permanence.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Forms the physical base of the still life around the bottle, concentrated in foreground and midground layers without touching or hiding the product.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Cedar shavings and a few small fragments appear suspended at different depths, with heavier pieces positioned near a subtle atmospheric current rather than arranged artificially.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: A translucent pearly haze, soft ivory fabric-like vapor and diffused highlights rather than a literal ingredient.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Musk is best expressed atmospherically as a clean, enveloping softness that unifies the citrus, florals, vanilla and wood.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A barely visible luminous veil in the background and around the negative-space typography zone, never obscuring the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled milky musk mist forms the spatial atmosphere and gently swirls behind and around the suspended bottle, creating depth without flattening the ingredients.

shared_visual_identity.concept: Luminous white petals suspended in a warm cedar-and-vanilla atmosphere: a refined passage from sparkling bergamot and orange blossom to soft jasmine, creamy vanilla, dry cedar and clean musk.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Communicate effortless elegance, intimate comfort and a softly radiant femininity that feels fresh in the opening and warmly enveloping in the drydown.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: A refined botanical studio atmosphere with a pale mineral surface, warm ivory background and softly diffused light, evolving into an immersive suspended floral-woody airspace in the surreal image.

editorial_still_life.concept: A luminous premium still life in which the upright bottle rests on a pale mineral surface surrounded by abundant but controlled clusters of citrus, white blossoms, vanilla and cedar, expressing the fragrance's elegant transition from freshness to warmth.

environment.description: The bottle stands completely vertical and stable on a low pale travertine or matte limestone slab. A softly graduated ivory studio wall creates an elegant setting. The foreground contains realistic citrus peel, a few cut bergamots and cedar shavings; the midground holds the bottle and principal white-flower groupings; the background carries delicate stems and a restrained pearly musk haze.
environment.background_rule: Use a softly graduated ivory-to-warm-cream background with subtle tonal depth, keeping generous clean negative space for Spanish typography while preserving a rich, tactile lower composition.

small cedar chips, bark fragments and fine shavings
a restrained translucent pearly musk haze in the background

composition.style: rich layered premium still life with an asymmetrical botanical grouping
composition.negative_space: generous upper-left and lateral negative space reserved for Spanish typography, with no text overlapping the bottle
composition.depth: clear foreground, midground and background layering with medium-shallow separation
composition.bottle_priority: highest; the bottle is the sharpest, most legible and most vertically dominant element

lighting.direction: large diffused key light from upper left with a gentle warm rim from the right
lighting.contrast: low to medium contrast with precise bottle highlights and softly defined botanical shadows

elements: Una estela suave de flores blancas, vainilla y cedro
NOTAS DE SALIDA: Bergamota · Flor de naranjo
NOTAS DE FONDO: Maderas de cedro · Musk · Vainilla
rules: Typography must remain in the designated negative space and must never cover the perfume bottle.
Keep the text concise, refined and highly legible.
Do not place typography over high-detail flowers, citrus or the bottle label.
Maintain a premium editorial hierarchy with the perfume name as the dominant text element.

immersive_surreal.concept: A suspended floral-woody current carries the perfume through a luminous pearly atmosphere: the bottle floats near the visual centre while bergamot, white blossoms, jasmine, vanilla and cedar occupy distinct physical depths within a gentle musk-infused air movement.

environment.description: The bottle floats near the centre on the main compositional axis, fully visible and separated from surrounding elements, with the cap subtly displaced to the left and the base to the right at a fixed 5-12 degree tilt. A pale mineral fragment and softly blurred botanical material occupy the foreground; the principal flowers, citrus and vanilla inhabit the midground; a deep ivory-gold musk haze and cedar-textured background create atmospheric depth. The scene extends naturally to all image edges without becoming an empty landscape.

visual_elements: one fully visible reference bottle suspended near the visual centre
foreground bergamot peel and partial cut citrus forms close to the lens, softly out of focus
midground clusters of orange blossom and jasmine at realistic scale
a few suspended whole and split vanilla pods
small cedar shavings and compact bark fragments at varied depths
subtle detached white petals moving through the air
pearly musk haze with warm ivory and champagne light
distant soft botanical silhouettes and mineral textures

composition.style: dynamic asymmetrical immersive composition with a clear central product axis
composition.depth: strong foreground, midground and background separation using realistic scale and medium-shallow focus
composition.bottle_priority: highest; the suspended bottle is the dominant sharp focal point and remains completely recognizable
composition.negative_space: controlled atmospheric breathing room around the bottle, with no typography and no visual obstruction of the cap, label or silhouette

materials: fresh citrus peel and juice droplets

lighting.direction: soft frontal key light with a warm upper-right rim and subtle backlight diffusing through the musk haze
lighting.contrast: medium controlled contrast, with luminous bottle edges, realistic glass reflections and grounded atmospheric shadows

negative_constraints: no typography in the immersive surreal image
no surreal bottle inversion or mirrored orientation
no artificial geometric floral arches, rings or crowns
